arcade.title: Phonics games
arcade.intro: Pick your level, then pick a game. Every game uses the sounds from that level.
arcade.dailyNote: One go at each game per day — little and often is how reading sticks.

blurbs.soundlings: Hatch and feed your own sound creatures
blurbs.pop: Fly Buzz the bee to pop the word you hear
blurbs.cannon: Aim and fire the right sound into the word
blurbs.run: Read the doors and run through the right one
blurbs.pairs: Flip the cards and match sounds to words
blurbs.finish: A sound is missing — tap the right one
blurbs.spot: Hunt the scene for things hiding the sound
blurbs.tricky: Listen and catch the tricky word

arcade.doneBlurb: Great playing! Come back tomorrow for another go.
arcade.notSureBody: Take the free 3-minute check and we'll place your child on the right one.

rotate.title: Turn your phone sideways to play!
rotate.body: This game is much bigger in landscape.
